text:
maya: spotting another OOM pattern on prod during sustained 95th pct load. reopening follow-up for remediation and tracking. postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pm/oom-pattern-2130999999

liam: quick pprof notes: trending RSS up across shards, fragmentation_ratio creeping. seeing many small arenas pinned by read-only snapshots.

aj: suspected culprit: allocator reserve + long-lived snapshot refs. proposing a short-term experiment: reduce arena decay time and add a periodic arena sweep after quiet windows.

sana: i'll prototype soft-evict; target to evict cold kv prefixes under memory pressure. will run in staging and report impact on latency.

rachel: adding dashboard panels for rss_p99, frag_ratio, arena_count; alert when p99 > reserved*0.9 for 10m. will schedule weekly drift triage.

maya: owners + due dates:
- liam: enable lightweight heap sampling cron (every 6-8h) and upload pipeline, due 2026-04-05
- sana: soft-evict implementation & staging runs, due 2026-03-31
- aj: allocator tuning experiments + RFC, due 2026-04-04
- rachel: dashboards/alerts + triage cadence, due 2026-03-28

liam: will also tag allocation spikes with request IDs to correlate requests to growth. PR #4050

sana: staging soft-evict PR #4053 shows ~15% reclaimed memory with minimal latency delta so far.

aj: I'll bench arena decay and a forced purge path; if safe we'll roll to canary.

maya: short sync tomorrow 9am PT to align on runbook steps. update the postmortem tracker when items complete. :thumbsup:
